errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява категориите – имената на страните
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The horizontal axis represents the numerical values (percentages), not the categories (countries). The vertical axis lists the countries.

errors.text_span: като редът е произволен, не следва азбучен или низходящ ред
errors.evidence: The countries are explicitly sorted in descending order based on their corresponding values. For example, Нидерландия (Netherlands) with the highest value (21.2) is at the top, and Ирландия (Ireland) with the lowest value (4.6) is at the bottom. The statement that the order is random is incorrect and also contradicts a later part of the description.
In this horizontal bar chart, the vertical axis represents the categories (countries), not the numerical values (percentages). The description has swapped the axes.

errors.text_span: сините стълби са за страни с по-ниски стойности, а червените – за страни с по-високи стойности
errors.evidence: This is a false interpretation of the color coding, which is not explained by a legend. For instance, Словакия (Slovakia) has a red bar and a value of 19.2, which is higher than Франция (France), which has a blue bar and a value of 16.5. Therefore, the color does not simply correlate with higher or lower values.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са изобразени като хоризонтални линии
errors.evidence: The visual elements are bars ('стълбове'), which have noticeable width. Describing them as lines ('линии') is an imprecise oversimplification.
